name: 70665 · Sulphur, LA
findings: ZIP 70665 (Sulphur) has 11 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70665 (Sulphur) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70665 (Sulphur) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
